mapper.select: SELECT id, scope_type, scope_id, purpose, key_id, key_algorithm, data_algorithm, encrypted_data_key, ciphertext, created_at, updated_at, rotated_at FROM secret_value WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO secret_value (scope_type, scope_id, workspace_id, org_id, purpose, key_id, key_algorithm, data_algorithm, encrypted_data_key, ciphertext) VALUES (#{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, CASE WHEN #{scopeType} = 'workspace' THEN #{scopeId} ELSE NULL END, CASE WHEN #{scopeType} = 'organization' THEN #{scopeId} ELSE NULL END, #{purpose}, #{keyId}, #{keyAlgorithm}, #{dataAlgorithm}, #{encryptedDataKey}, #{ciphertext}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id), workspace_id = VALUES(workspace_id), org_id = VALUES(org_id), key_id = VALUES(key_id), key_algorithm = VALUES(key_algorithm), data_algorithm = VALUES(data_algorithm), encrypted_data_key = VALUES(encrypted_data_key), ciphertext = VALUES(ciphertext), rotated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
